input._script:
export PATH=/ccc/scratch/cont002/cerfacs/drozdalu/software/julia-1.13.0/bin:$PATH
export JULIA_DEPOT_PATH=/ccc/scratch/cont002/cerfacs/drozdalu/.julia
mpirun -np 2 --map-by ppr:1:node julia -e '
using MPI, CUDA
MPI.Init()
comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank = MPI.Comm_rank(comm)
CUDA.device!(0)
buf = CUDA.fill(Float32(rank), 4)
if rank == 0
    MPI.Send(buf, comm; dest=1, tag=0)
else
    MPI.Recv!(buf, comm; source=0, tag=0)
    ok = Array(buf) == Float32[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    println(ok ? "PASS: multi_node" : "FAIL: multi_node")
end
'
